title: Cross-Device Ledger Sync - Rework 1
outcome_summary: All 12 work packages completed in a single session with zero regressions, growing the test suite from 3,842 to 3,883+ tests (all passing). The core deliverable — extending `resolveProjectPath()` with multi-store detection — closes the last functional gap where 28 call sites would silently miss projects in non-default stores. Supporting changes include store-scoped insight `formatted_id`, global pagination in `MultiStoreManager`, GUI repo listing consolidation, `SLUG_REGEX`/`StoreListItem` schema migration, and CLI test isolation hardening. Three medium-priority items remain for the next cycle: fixing the `knowledge.ts` direct-iteration pagination asymmetry, deleting an empty `stores.json` on last-store removal, and exporting `resetStoreContext()` for hermetic test teardown.
project_summary: This project completes the multi-store ledger architecture by addressing all synthesis items from the initial cross-device-ledger-sync project. Key changes include updating project-resolver.ts for multi-store detection across all 28 tool call sites, consolidating GUI repo handlers, introducing store-scoped insight IDs, extracting shared schema constants, hardening CLI test isolation, and fixing edge cases in store operations.
